title: Maude Native Launch
subtitle: Launch video-comp — the 22.6 sneak peek → the full native desktop app
brief: Social launch clip (~12s, no VO, music bed) for the native Maude desktop app. Callback to the June sneak peek (a single diff-viewer screen), then reveal the whole app across six frame-driven beats: june diff (dimmed) → zoom out → six-phase montage (shell/git/identity/collab/chat/distribution) → ready for non-technical people (no terminal) → runs on macOS + Windows → download CTA (maude.sh/desktop). On the maude DS (indigo accent, spark mark, Inter Tight). Diff red/green used only for the literal git-diff callback. Export ⌘E → MP4/GIF or /design:export mp4 --scope artboard.
